criteria_source: IsoScout assembly-comparison v2: 85% target and candidate alignment coverage and 500 bp minimum alignment are explicit workflow criteria, not user requirements or strain cutoffs. Mapping quality 5 follows paftools call defaults. No density or contig-edge SNP filtering. Ranking now uses the intersection of qualifying target regions, with the same recorded target-coverage floor. Excluded alternatives with no larger raw SNP count or rate block a resolved genome conclusion; a different or unknown label also blocks cluster resolution.
metric: ACGT substitutions called by paftools in uniquely covered target regions; indels reported separately
